summary: United Microelectronics Corp (UMC) filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of its 22nd share buy-back plan. The repurchase period was April 30 to June 29, 2026, with a maximum of 50 million shares and a price range of NTD 52.50 to 109.50 per share. Actual repurchase occurred May 5–20, 2026, acquiring 30,551,000 shares (0.24% of outstanding) for NTD 3,095,665,789, averaging NTD 101.33 per share. The program was not fully executed due to market conditions and shareholder interest. No advisors named. This is a routine buyback involving issuer repurchasing own shares; watch for further buyback plan announcements or share cancellation.
